plot: On the first morning in the new house (Mia had saved it as 'Grandma's house' because Grandma lives with them now) Lolly refuses to leave the sunny windowsill — her first window ever — while the sun melts her icing; Zeek's cookbook wall vanishes when Grandma picks it up, Crispy points out the striped shadow, the tassel Pim tripped on turns out to be a blind cord caught on a high hook, and — the twist — scared Pim climbs it for Lolly; the blind comes down, her icing sets into a crown, and from the top Pim sees Dad carry Mr. Pot in from the moving truck.

beats.say: I'm dripping! Why are my points dripping?!
Lolly, your icing is sliding down your face!
First morning in the new house. A giant sunny window.
Lolly picked the windowsill. Now the sun is melting her.
New episode every day. Subscribe so you don't miss what happens next.
And the wrong way? It wasn't wrong at all.
Mia saved the new house as 'Grandma's house'.
Grandma lives here now. With all of them.
So Grandma's house is our house. Best mistake ever.
Lovely. Now somebody make the sun stop!
Easy. Get off the windowsill. Into the shade.
No! I lived in a dark pantry my whole life.
My first window ever. I can see the whole street!
Outside: a jogger, a mail truck, the moving truck.
It's pretty. But you're m-melting, Lolly. Like, a lot.
Pim trips on a cord by the window. It has a tassel.
What is this rope for? Is it a trap?
Decoration. Humans hang strings on everything. Ignore it.
Zeek has a better idea. Grandma's giant cookbook.
Stand it up. Instant wall. Instant shade.
The cookbook stands. Lolly sits in its cool shadow.
Ahh. Shade. I could live here forever.
Then Grandma walks in and picks up the cookbook.
One more hour and I'm a puddle with a face!
The sun climbs higher. The tiles get warmer.
Okay team. Lolly, I'm sorry, but we're carrying you.
Touch one point and I'll ice you to the floor!
Nobody touches her. Nobody ever touches angry Lolly.
A low voice comes from under the shelf.
I've lived in shadows for years. Shadows are never still.
Look at the wall. Something up there makes stripes.
On the window: a rolled-up blind. The tassel cord is its string.
It's not decoration. It's a blind! Pull it, shade comes down!
But the cord is caught on a hook, up by the ceiling.
Someone has to climb up there and flip it free.
Bup is a loaf. Crispy is too heavy. Zeek can't see.
I'll do it.
Pim, you're scared of the bottom stair.
You sing to me every night. My turn.
Pim grabs the cord. He climbs. Hand over hand. Bean over bean.
Then Grandma comes back. She reaches for the window handle.
If that window opens, the cord swings. Pim goes flying!
Pim is halfway. His bandage slips. He dangles by one hand.
PIM! YOU HOLD ON RIGHT NOW!
Yes ma'am! Holding on! Very much holding on!
Grandma stops. Sniffs her tea. Walks off to find sugar.
Pim reaches the hook. He flips the cord free. Zip!
The blind rolls down. Striped shade falls over the windowsill.
Lolly's icing stops dripping. It sets like a little crown.
My window, my street, and stripes. It's perfect.
Don't tell anyone I climbed. Especially not me.
Too late. You're a climber now, Pim.
From up there, Pim sees the moving truck.
Dad carries in one last thing. Black. Round. Three eyes.
Fresh... dough. Did you miss me?
What do you think happens in the next part?
Tell me in the comments.

long.title: Why Is Lolly Melting? ☀️ (Ep 17)
long.description:
What do you think happens in the next part? Tell me in the comments.
"My first window ever. I wasn't leaving it, even if I melted." — Lolly
First morning in the new house: the sun is melting Lolly's icing, the only shade is up a cord near the ceiling, and the one who has to climb it is scared of the bottom stair.
#series #3DAnimation #DoughBros

es.title: ¿Por qué se está derritiendo Lolly? ☀️ (Ep 17)
es.description:
¿Qué crees que pasa en la siguiente parte? Cuéntamelo en los comentarios.
"Mi primera ventana. No pensaba irme, aunque me derritiera." — Lolly
Primera mañana en la casa nueva: el sol derrite el glaseado de Lolly, la única sombra está tras un cordón junto al techo, y quien debe trepar le teme hasta al primer escalón.
#serie #Animación3D #DoughBros

pt.title: Por que a Lolly está derretendo? ☀️ (Ep 17)
pt.description:
O que você acha que acontece na próxima parte? Conta nos comentários.
"Minha primeira janela. Eu não ia sair dali, nem derretendo." — Lolly
Primeira manhã na casa nova: o sol está derretendo a cobertura da Lolly, a única sombra depende de uma cordinha lá perto do teto, e quem precisa subir tem medo até do primeiro degrau.
#série #Animação3D #DoughBros

ar.title: لماذا تذوب لولي؟ ☀️ (Ep 17)
ar.description:
ماذا تظن أنه سيحدث في الجزء القادم؟ أخبرني في التعليقات.
"أول نافذة في حياتي. لم أكن سأتركها حتى لو ذبت." — لولي
أول صباح في البيت الجديد: الشمس تذيب طبقة السكر على لولي، والظل الوحيد معلّق بحبل قرب السقف، ومن عليه أن يتسلقه يخاف حتى من الدرجة الأولى.
#مسلسل #رسوم_ثلاثية_الأبعاد #DoughBros

fr.title: Pourquoi Lolly est-elle en train de fondre ? ☀️ (Ep 17)
fr.description:
À ton avis, que se passe-t-il dans la prochaine partie ? Dis-le-moi en commentaire.
"Ma toute première fenêtre. Je ne la quittais pas, même en fondant." — Lolly
Premier matin dans la nouvelle maison : le soleil fait fondre le glaçage de Lolly, la seule ombre dépend d'un cordon près du plafond, et celui qui doit grimper a peur de la première marche.
#série #Animation3D #DoughBros

ja.title: どうしてロリーが溶けてるの？ ☀️ (Ep 17)
ja.description:
次のパートで何が起きると思う？コメントで教えてね。
「生まれて初めての窓。溶けたって離れるつもりはなかった。」— ロリー
新しい家の最初の朝。日差しがロリーのアイシングを溶かしていく。日陰を作るには天井近くのひもを外すしかない。登らなきゃいけないのは、階段の一段目すら怖いあの子だった。
#シリーズ #3Dアニメ #DoughBros

ko.title: 롤리는 왜 녹고 있을까? ☀️ (Ep 17)
ko.description:
다음 편에서는 무슨 일이 일어날까요? 댓글로 알려 주세요.
"내 인생 첫 창문이야. 녹더라도 떠날 생각 없었어." — 롤리
새 집에서의 첫 아침. 햇빛이 롤리의 아이싱을 녹이고, 그늘을 만들 방법은 천장 근처의 줄뿐인데, 올라가야 하는 건 계단 첫 칸도 무서워하는 친구다.
#시리즈 #3D애니메이션 #DoughBros

de.title: Warum schmilzt Lolly? ☀️ (Ep 17)
de.description:
Was glaubst du, passiert im nächsten Teil? Schreib es in die Kommentare.
"Mein allererstes Fenster. Ich wollte nicht weg, auch wenn ich schmelze." — Lolly
Erster Morgen im neuen Haus: Die Sonne schmilzt Lollys Zuckerguss, der einzige Schatten hängt an einer Schnur unter der Decke, und klettern muss ausgerechnet der, der schon vor der untersten Stufe Angst hat.
#Serie #3DAnimation #DoughBros
